q: What must a Frankfurt data centre report about waste heat reuse?
title: Frankfurt data centres: waste heat reporting
short: Under the EU Energy Efficiency Directive, data centres with installed IT power of 500 kW or more report key indicators every year to a European database, including energy use and how much waste heat is reused. The delegated act sets the indicators, such as the energy reuse factor.
audience: Data centre operators in the Frankfurt hub in Germany and their large tenants

p: Article 12 of Directive (EU) 2023/1791 covers data centres with an installed IT power demand of at least 500 kW. Delegated Regulation (EU) 2024/1364 sets what they report and how.

ul: Total energy consumption and IT energy, giving PUE.
Waste heat reused, as an energy reuse factor.

p: Member states can add their own requirements on top. Check German law for any reuse targets that apply to your site.

senseible: Senseible reads each site's monthly electricity bills into a dated Scope 2 record, keeps renewable purchase documents beside them for market-based reporting, and records diesel for backup generators as Scope 1. Customer shares use the allocation key you enter.
